input.title: Unclear scope for site setup
input.message: The short and long texts only state "Baustelle vollständig einrichten und vorhalten" without specifying the required facilities, equipment, duration or standards, violating VOB/A § 7 Abs. 1 (eindeutig, erschöpfend).
input.suggestion: Detail the required facilities (e.g., site office, storage, sanitation, safety fencing) with dimensions, duration and applicable standards.
